selection_definition.fusion_scope: EWSR1::NR4A3 and TAF15::NR4A3; NR4A3 rearrangement; FET-family expansion is a candidate generator, not a claim every EMC has a FET fusion. TCF12 variant is a boundary case.
selection_definition.name: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
selection_definition.synonym_note: Canonical and hyphenation/short-name variants plus ambiguous abbreviation; broader myxoid term deliberately favors ordinary baseline.
